artifact_delivered: Q-learning agent for gridworld — bin/q_learning.py implements tabular Q-learning with value iteration comparison
workstream_summary: C529: Built Q-learning agent applying C527 value methods (Q-values, TD learning) to gridworld MDP. Agent achieves 99.6% success rate on 4x4 grid, converges to near-optimal policy. Includes value iteration baseline for comparison, learning curve tracking, policy visualization. Bridges RL theory (C527) to practical agent that learns from interaction.
